def generate_markdown(doc):
    """
    Generate a Markdown document from a numpydoc dictionary.

    Parameters
    ----------
    doc : dict
        Dictionary produced by numpydoc

    Returns
    -------
    str
        Markdown document
    """
    return '\n'.join([
        generate_title(doc),
        generate_description(doc),
        generate_parameters(doc),
        generate_returns(doc),
        generate_examples(doc),
        generate_references(doc),
    ])


def generate_title(doc):
    """
    Generate a title for a Markdown document.

    Parameters
    ----------
    doc : dict
        Dictionary produced by numpydoc

    Returns
    -------
    str
        Markdown title
    """
    return '## {0}'.format(doc['name'])


def generate_description(doc):
    """
    Generate a description for a Markdown document.

    Parameters
    ----------
    doc : dict
        Dictionary produced by numpydoc

    Returns
    -------
    str
        Markdown description
    """
    return doc['summary']
